rubric.description: Rubric for evaluating Ethereum assembly objects composed from technical primitives.

criteria.name: Modularity
criteria.definition: Is the assembly composed of reusable components that can integrate across contexts or other assemblies?

criteria.name: Cognitive Expansion
criteria.definition: Does the assembly enable new forms of action, sensing, feedback, or decision-making for users or systems?

criteria.name: Mutualism
criteria.definition: Does the assembly support cooperation, public goods production, localism, or trust-based coordination?

criteria.name: Novelty
criteria.definition: Is the combination of primitives surprising, generative, or uniquely emergent in function or form?

criteria.name: Feasibility
criteria.definition: Is the assembly plausible and implementable using current Ethereum tooling and infrastructure?

rubric.scoring_method: Each proposed assembly object is scored from 1–5 on each of the 5 criteria. Highest total score wins per cycle unless otherwise justified by evaluator rationale.
